Change-Order Proposal – Additional CRM Connector

1. Original Scope
Existing signed scope is the reporting dashboard.

2. Requested Work
Client requests an additional CRM connector. It is not included in the original fee.

3. Price
40 hours at $175/hour. Proposed fixed change fee of $7,000.

4. Dependency
Client must provide sandbox credentials.

5. Schedule Effect
Connector adds two weeks after written approval and credential receipt. This is an estimate, not an approved calendar date.

6. Approval
Sponsor must approve in writing before connector work begins.

Please approve or decline:
[ ] Approve
[ ] Decline
Signature: __________ Date: __________
